# Lock and Key Locksmith
> Mobile locksmith based in Georgetown, Delaware, serving all 50 towns of Kent and Sussex County. Lockouts, rekeys, car keys and fobs, commercial locks. Phone (302) 271-0155.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://lockandkeylocksmithde.com/): Services, coverage map and how a call works
- [About](https://lockandkeylocksmithde.com/about/): Who runs the business and how jobs are handled
- [Services](https://lockandkeylocksmithde.com/services/): Every locksmith service offered
- [Service areas](https://lockandkeylocksmithde.com/service-areas/): All towns served in Kent and Sussex County
- [Blog](https://lockandkeylocksmithde.com/blog/): Locksmith guides for Delaware homes, cars and businesses
- [FAQ](https://lockandkeylocksmithde.com/faq/): Answers to common locksmith questions
- [Press](https://lockandkeylocksmithde.com/press/): Press coverage and mentions

## Key facts
- Service model: mobile van, no storefront; comes to the customer's address
- Hours: Sun-Thu 7:00am-10:00pm, Fri 7:00am-3:30pm, Sat closed
- Service area: Kent County and Sussex County, Delaware
